title: Bare Bones x Stranger Things
description: Adds simplified textures for Swirly's Stranger Things mod in the style of Bare Bones.
body:
This simple resource pack makes Swirly's Stranger Things mod look more simplistic, with textures resembling [Bare Bones](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones). Currently, his mod is only available in his [discord](https://discord.gg/sm3MVCB5W2).

Requires [PillowFillow's Resource Pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pf-st-textures) to function.
